title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  
  
AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.
  
  
AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.
  
  
Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
* Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
* Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
* Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
* Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
* Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
* Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
* Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
* Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
* Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

  
A day in the life  
As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.
  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent
* 10+ years of experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with or having knowledge of cloud computing and existing cloud technologies
* Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning
* Experience in making data driven business decisions

description:
**Role Summary**

Proxgy is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and dynamic **Store Manager** to oversee our central inventory and warehouse operations. In this role, you will be the backbone of our physical supply chain, managing the lifecycle of our innovative deep-tech IoT hardware products, smart wearables, and industrial safety devices (such as SmartHats, ProHats, smart locks, and tracking units).

You will be responsible for end-to-end store operations, stock accuracy, seamless inward and outward dispatches, RTO handling, and efficient tracking of device movements across internal departments like R&D, Quality Assurance, Production, and Sales.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Store & Inventory Management**

* Maintain **100% inventory accuracy** through systematic stock-taking, cycle counting, and ledger reconciliations.
* Organize and maintain the physical store layout for optimal storage, easy retrieval, and safety of sensitive electronic components, finished IoT devices, and raw materials.
* Implement robust Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or ERP-driven tracking procedures to monitor stock levels in real time.
* Prevent stock obsolescence, shrinkage, or damage through proactive stock rotations and secure storage practices.

**2. Inward and Outward Dispatches**

* Supervise all **inward shipments**, ensuring rigorous quality checks on incoming raw materials, components, and vendor supplies against purchase orders (POs).
* Manage **outward dispatches** for B2B clients, field deployments, and e-commerce channels, ensuring timely, secure, and cost-effective shipping.
* Coordinate with third-party logistics (3PL) partners and courier services to ensure hassle-free final-mile delivery.
* Ensure all dispatch documentation (eway bills, tax invoices, delivery challans, and packing slips) is meticulously generated and archived.

**3. RTO (Return to Origin) Management**

* Streamline the **RTO and reverse logistics process** by efficiently tracking, receiving, and inspecting returned shipments from clients or transit hubs.
* Categorize returned devices based on condition (e.g., for restocking, refurbishment, or scrapping) and coordinate with the technical/repair teams for rapid turnaround.
* Maintain comprehensive logs and metrics for RTO rates, identifying root causes to minimize future delivery failures.

**4. Internal Device Movement & Inter-Departmental Coordination**

* Track and oversee the issuance, transfer, and return of devices across internal departments (**R&D, Production, QA, and Sales/Demo teams**).
* Maintain strict chain-of-custody logs for prototype hardware, testing units, and high-value demonstration kits moving within the organization.
* Conduct regular internal audits to reconcile physical assets assigned to various teams versus system records.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience:** 2 to 4 years of proven experience in warehouse management, storekeeping, or inventory control, preferably within a hardware, electronics, or IoT manufacturing setup.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Technical Skills:**

Proficiency in using ERP systems, WMS software, and advanced MS Excel.

Strong understanding of barcode scanning, inventory tagging, and SKU management.

**Core Competencies:**

Excellent organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail.

Strong problem-solving abilities regarding logistics bottlenecks and transit discrepancies.

Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with fast-paced engineering and sales teams.

Job Title: Nutrition Officer/ Executive

About the role


This is a field role focused on ethical engagement with Health Care Professionals (HCPs) to share scientific, evidence‑based information on infant nutrition and Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition portfolio. The role requires clear and compliant communication of product features, advantages and benefits, and their appropriate use—strictly within Nestlé’s Code of Ethics, company instructions, and the Indian Code. The role consistently upholds the principle that mother’s milk is best for babies.

  

Job Description (Key Responsibilities)  

* Ethically promote Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition products to HCPs by clearly communicating


product features, advantages, benefits and appropriate use, in line with company Code  

of Ethics and the Indian Code; reinforce that mother’s milk is best for babies.  

* Ensure recommendations for the Nestlé Nutrition product range remain within the


scope of the Indian Code; detail against homemade paps and bovine milk as  

appropriate.  

* Serve as a reliable source of information on infant nutrition and infant feeding practices


for HCPs.  

* Plan and execute high‑quality scientific detailing, CMEs/symposiums and other


scientific activities as per company guidelines.  

* Map and segment HCPs in the assigned territory; develop and execute an effective


coverage plan and call cycle.  

* Maintain accurate records of HCP interactions, feedback, and scientific events; provide


timely reports as per guidance.  

* Identify opportunities and potential within the territory and contribute inputs to drive


demand generation activities within compliance.  

* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure availability of compliant scientific materials


and support tools for field execution.  

Qualifications  

* Graduate with at least 1 year of experience in a field sales role in either a Nutrition


company or the pharmaceutical industry.  

* High level of integrity and honesty; hardworking, self‑motivated, and passionate about


enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.  

* Ability to work effectively in a team and build strong, sustainable relationships with


stakeholders.  

* High learning agility; trustworthy and able to work independently within company


policies and guidelines.
